controlledPreview.boundary: The actual unchanged production BayeHdCityPlans reader computes all 12 DTO rows (8 allied local march and 4 transport rows, including ten long member names, repeated member IDs, sparse member slots and Food 65535/0) from explicit deep read-only mock native data and mock original identity. An ignored build-only copy of production hd-city-menu appends state/renderStatus exports, then actual renderStatus/appendStat produces the status DOM. Entry city-menu markup, mobile header/stage markup, inline styles, production CSS/font and inline resource SVG are pinned. Mobile lifecycle, UI event binding and engine polling never start. This is an instrumented renderer DOM/CSS layout preview, not a running actual city menu, natural play, real device or full HD acceptance.
controlledPreview.processBoundary: One new owned Chrome persistent context/profile and private ephemeral HTTP; all owned pages/context/server closed. No existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.

visualReview.method: All 9 exact-viewport PNGs were opened as complete images with tools.view_image after the owned Chrome context and HTTP server had closed.
notes: PC and both simulated landscape mobile plans captures show long ten-member march rows wrapping fully within value cells. First march carries 65535 and second carries 0; repeated IDs and sparse-slot order remain visibly preserved.

Transport rows remain mixed with march rows and retain Food/Money/reserve-Arms text. Bottom captures show a complete final march row with Food 0. The status viewport intentionally clips vertically scrolled content at its boundaries, and scroll measurements prove the complete final row is reachable.

No horizontal clipping or ellipsis was observed. The narrow 667x375 plans note and march rows wrap across additional lines. Return remains completely visible at 44px height in every capture; exact image pixel dimensions match all declared viewports.

Production plans reader produces the exact public DTO shape and text; a build-only appended export exposes the actual production renderStatus/appendStat renderer. Explicit mock identity and deeply read-only mock world data are used, with rejection getters on uninitialized march Money/Arms/Consume/TimeCount. All rejection/native-key/native-write/automatic-click counters stay zero.

Mobile lifecycle, event binding, polling, main, original LIB and WASM never start. These images cover controlled instrumented renderer layout only, not actual city play, natural settlement, physical device or full-HD acceptance.

controlledPreview.scopeLimit: Exactly 1280x720 PC and 844x390/667x375 simulated landscape mobile. Only the actual plans source reader plus instrumented production status renderer and extracted entry markup/CSS are covered. Mobile lifecycle, binding and engine integration do not run. No existing game, native input, world write, natural-play flow, physical-device or full-HD acceptance.

rootVisualReview.method: Root viewed three representative original PNGs with tools.view_image; preview reviewer viewed all nine.
rootVisualReview.notes: Ten-member long names and stored food wrap without ellipsis; last row accessible. Existing two-column status layout remains dense at 667px and is a next UI improvement.
